levels.label: 52-week high

levels.label: 21-day average (resistance)

levels.label: 50-day average
levels.note: Key support for leaders; a close below on heavy volume is a warning.

levels.label: 2 x ATR below today's close
levels.note: ATR(14) is 2.27; two ATRs is a common volatility-based distance for judging noise vs a real move.

levels.label: 7-8% below today's close
levels.note: O'Neil's rule of thumb is to cut losses 7-8% below the purchase price. Shown from today's close (64.93 to 65.64) for scale only.
